title: A range edge above the corridor, with caution
why: Rule 4 trades an edge: MCD2 is a flat range with the price above its upper edge, so both trader types get a SHORT (archetype D, trend relation COUNTER_TREND by decision D1 (d)); MCD1 is an ordinary uptrend, so it has no range branch to stand aside for. MCD2 and MCD3 are CAUTIONARY from an MCD0 defect on M5, and MCD3 sees a trend conflict, so the readings carry the MCD0 code and the modifier's caution. The price is above the whole M5 channel, so there are no zones (NO_ZONE_SOURCES).
